Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 899 of 2023
Revisionist :- Fareeduddin @ Phultar Thru.
His Mother Smt. Fatima Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lucknow And 4 Others Counsel for Revisionist :- Mohd. Tabrez Iqbal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ashutosh Kumar Singh Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Mohd. Tabrez Iqbal, learned counsel appearing for the revisionist, Sri Anant Pratap Singh, the learned Additional Government Advocate and perused the record.
2.

By means of the instant revision filed under Section 102 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, the revisionist has challenged the validity of the orders dated 14.03.2023 passed by the Juvenile Justice Board, Shrawasti rejecting his application for release on bail and the order dated 28.04.2023 passed by the Additional Session Judge/ Special Judge (POCSO Act), Shrawasti dismissing Criminal Appeal No. 23 of 2023 filed by the revisionist against the order rejecting his bail application.

sentences.text: 3.The opposite party no. 2 lodged an FIR No. 170 of 2022 on 06.05.2022 alleging that the applicant had enticed away the complainant's daughter aged about 14 years.
In the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., she stated that she had gone with the revisionist out of Fareeduddin @ Phultar Thru.

The victim declined to undergo medico legal examination.
However, in the radiological examination conducted to ascertain the age of the victim has been opined to be 16 years of age whereas the age of the revisionist has been opined to be 13 years.
4. Social Enquiry Report submitted by District Probation Officer contains no such recommendation as would warrant continuance of the revisionist's custody.
5. Keeping in view the aforesaid recommendations of the District Probationary Officer, I am of the view that the revision deserves to be allowed.
6. Accordingly, this revision stands allowed.

The orders dated 14.03.2023 passed by the Juvenile Justice Board, Shrawasti and the order dated 28.04.2023 passed by the Additional Session Judge/
Special Judge (POCSO Act), Shrawasti, are set aside.

entities.text:
Additional Session Judge/
Special Judge (POCSO Act), Shrawasti
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
7. Let the revisionist-Juvenile be released on bail in Case Crime No. 170 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC & Sections 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Bhinga, District Shrawasti upon his guardian furnishing a personal bond with two solvent sureties of his relatives, each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Juvenile Justice Board concerned subject to the following conditions:-
(i) the natural guardian will furnish an undertaking that upon release on bail the juvenile will not be permitted to come into contact or association with any known criminal or allowed to be exposed to any moral, physical or psychological danger and further that the guardian will ensure that the juvenile will not indulge in any criminal activity;
(ii) natural guardian will further furnish an undertaking to the effect that the juvenile will pursue his study at the appropriate level which he would be encouraged to do.
(iii) juvenile accompanied by his natural guardian, will report to the Probation Officer on the first working day of every calendar month.
The D.P.O. shall maintain a diary recording their attendance.

(iv) The District Probation Officer will keep strict vigil on the activities of the juvenile and regularly draw up his social investigation report that would be submitted to the Juvenile Justice Board concerned.
8.

It is made clear that the observations made in this order are limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
The trial court/J.J.Board shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led, uninfluenced by any finding or observation whatsoever in this order.
